note: This file is a configuration file (no callable functions, classes, or CLI entry points). It defines hyperparameters for the DINO object detection model using MMDetection's mmengine config system.
summarize_config: summarize the DINO 4-scale ResNet-50 improved config for COCO object detection training
review_model_hyperparameters: review the model hyperparameters including backbone freezing, loss weights, and positional encoding settings
review_optimizer_settings: review the optimizer settings including learning rate and parameter-wise learning rate multipliers
build_dino_detector: build a DINO 4-scale object detector with improved hyperparameters for COCO dataset training
run_dino_training: run the DINO 4-scale ResNet-50 improved configuration for 12 epochs on COCO
